Overview

Santa Ana is a city in CA with a population of 310,227. Orange County hub with Latino culture, art districts, and expensive California living. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 278 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
